sources.title: Tool specification planning
sources.supports: router construction and model-visible tool specifications
sources.limitations: does not prove provider-side model behavior

evidence_points.point: build_tool_router constructs the router/specification projection

sources.title: Tool router parsing
sources.supports: response-item parsing and call-id preservation
sources.limitations: does not establish every provider response shape

evidence_points.point: build_tool_call matches response item variants and constructs ToolCall

sources.title: Tool invocation construction
sources.supports: ToolInvocation fields and dispatch handoff
sources.limitations: field semantics remain implementation-specific

evidence_points.point: router destructures ToolCall and builds ToolInvocation before registry dispatch

sources.title: Tool registry
sources.supports: registration, duplicate detection, lookup, lifecycle dispatch
sources.limitations: does not establish external policy semantics

evidence_points.point: from_tools rejects duplicate names and dispatch_any looks up runtimes

sources.title: Registry hook lifecycle
sources.supports: pre/post hook and result conversion behavior
sources.limitations: hook implementations vary by runtime

evidence_points.point: CoreToolRuntime exposes pre/post payload conversion and updated hook input

sources.title: Execution policy evaluation
sources.supports: policy-derived approval requirements
sources.limitations: configuration-dependent and not a universal allow/deny table

evidence_points.point: policy service derives an ExecApprovalRequirement from command and config

sources.title: Approval and sandbox primitives
sources.supports: cached approval decisions and approval actions
sources.limitations: interactive reviewer implementation is outside this source

evidence_points.point: with_cached_approval reads and writes the shared approval store

sources.title: Sandbox override rules
sources.supports: sandbox/escalation and denied-read preservation
sources.limitations: platform-specific sandbox executors are separate crates

evidence_points.point: override logic prevents unsandboxed execution when denied reads exist

sources.title: Parallel tool runtime
sources.supports: parallel admission, cancellation, and cleanup
sources.limitations: timing behavior depends on runtime cooperation

evidence_points.point: parallel runtime selects a gate based on support and observes cancellation

sources.title: Unified execution runtime
sources.supports: process and exec-server execution boundary
sources.limitations: does not prove host OS behavior beyond adapter calls

evidence_points.point: UnifiedExecRuntime implements approval, sandbox, and run adapters

sources.title: Apply patch handler
sources.supports: patch parsing, permission checks, progress, and result output
sources.limitations: actual filesystem effects depend on environment

evidence_points.point: handler consumes ToolInvocation and emits call-correlated patch events/results

sources.title: MCP tool handler
sources.supports: namespaced MCP provider routing and result conversion
sources.limitations: remote server behavior is outside this repository

evidence_points.point: McpHandler names, parses, invokes, and converts MCP calls

sources.title: App-server turn processor
sources.supports: client request to session turn routing
sources.limitations: wire compatibility depends on protocol version

evidence_points.point: turn processor maps versioned requests into session operations

sources.title: Registry completion and dispatch trace
sources.supports: call-id correlation and success/failure telemetry
sources.limitations: telemetry sinks may be unavailable

evidence_points.point: dispatch completion records call-correlated response and trace outcome

sources.title: Session event persistence
sources.supports: event-to-rollout persistence boundary
sources.limitations: store filtering and compaction have additional rules

evidence_points.point: session conditionally persists emitted rollout items

sources.title: Session history preparation
sources.supports: history projection and normalization boundary
sources.limitations: context manager applies additional projection rules

evidence_points.point: session prepares response items for history projection

sources.title: Unsupported tool-call errors
sources.supports: explicit failure handling for unsupported payloads
sources.limitations: individual runtimes add their own errors

evidence_points.point: registry has explicit unsupported-call and failed-dispatch paths

sources.title: Parallel cancellation tests
sources.supports: tested cancellation lifecycle distinctions
sources.limitations: tests cover selected fixtures, not every runtime

evidence_points.point: tests assert cancellation timing and cleanup lifecycle outcomes

sources.title: Dynamic tool response matching
sources.supports: pending dynamic call lookup by call ID
sources.limitations: provider callback timing is external

evidence_points.point: notify_dynamic_tool_response removes pending state by call_id and warns when absent

sources.title: Tool exposure override
sources.supports: separation between handler registration and exposure state
sources.limitations: exposure alone does not enumerate all policy controls

evidence_points.point: registry can wrap a handler with a distinct exposure value
